name: Heroes of Newerth Reborn
summary:
Heroes of Newerth: Reborn is a modern reimagining of the beloved classic MOBA, rebuilt from the ground up to deliver the fastest, most fluid, and most intense gameplay experience in the genre. Designed for both veterans and new players alike, Reborn captures the heart and soul of the original Heroes of Newerth while enhancing every aspect. From visuals and performance to balance and accessibility.

Every hero has been reworked with updated models, refined animations, and rebalanced abilities to preserve their identity while elevating their impact on the battlefield. The iconic Newerth map returns with a fresh look, optimized pathing, and improved clarity for competitive play. Whether you're diving into fast-paced solo queue battles or coordinating with friends in ranked modes, the focus is on skill expression, teamwork, and lightning-fast decision-making. With smoother servers, enhanced visuals, and the same fierce edge that made HoN legendary, Heroes of Newerth: Reborn isn’t just a revival, it’s an evolution.
